Description.value: Repositions/resizes CATUI's rebuilt craftingInfoPanel elements (search tabs, ingredients, stat panel, crafting queue) to fit Project Z's wider layout. Pixel values recovered from the original ZZZ_CATUI_ProjectZ_compatible patch, minus the recipeCraftCountControl-in-preview logic that caused the original NullReferenceException crash (that's fixed properly in Project Z's own file instead, inside itemActions).
